svg.title: B — Sitka light-edge and tree-base transition concept
svg.desc: Original schematic depicting an irregular visual continuum from shaded spruce interior to brighter margin, a root-and-litter base study and H1/footpath/planting interface constraints.

g.text: Dense litter, low stature and contrast
Optional grasses, fern or bramble pockets
No stamped circular tree basins; no straight colour seam. Variation should follow actual authored light/site intent.
Shade and light labels identify possible material variants — not simulated post-thinning state.

svg.text: BOUNDARY DETAIL / plan view, not a geometry proposal
≤0.20 m visual verge / G1 planting points
No mesh, collision or path topology changes
Lighting, wetness and edge response remain authored visual calibrations unless a separate approved ecological state exists.
